findings.passage: Coming through the pandemic, we managed to have one of the most productive and successful sessions in my recent memory. Here's a few of our accomplishments: overrode the Governor's Veto on SB 50 to provide tax relief, passed property tax transparency with SB 13, expanded telemedicine and healthcare access in SB 14, created a loan program for economic recovery in SB 15, passed sweeping Department of Labor changes with audits and accountability, passed comprehensive education funding and policy package in HB 2134, strengthened election laws in HB 2183 and 2058, and passed the Value Them Both Constitutional Amendment to be offered to the voters in 2022... just to name a few.
findings.note: Her 2021 re-election campaign mailer (undated; titled 2021 legislative session). Only a passing claim that election laws were strengthened; no position on ID or citizenship stated.
